title: DeskAgentResponseEnvelope
description: Standard response / execution result envelope for Desk Agent R1

request_id.description: Matches the request_id from the originating RequestEnvelope

status.description: Lifecycle terminal or intermediate state. 'accepted' means acknowledged but not complete; 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'unknown' indicate resolution state.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of response generation

result.description: Domain-specific output payload when status is succeeded or accepted

error.description: Standardized error descriptor when status is failed or unknown

retryable.description: Indicates whether the caller may safely retry with the same request_id

execution_duration_ms.description: Total execution elapsed time in milliseconds
